card.title: Our Private Language
card.instruction: Use old references, shorthand, and familiar rhythms as proof that this connection exists beneath whatever has changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Purple umbrellas. Please tell me our old escape signal still works at your office parties.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're divorced. And that meant order dessert.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remember the menu version. With the eyebrow, it means rescue me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get you a taxi after pudding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pudding, then rescue. You still speak it better than I do.
